verses.text_uthmani: الٓمٓ

translations.text: Alif Lam Mim
Alif Laam Meem

verses.text_uthmani: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ

translations.text: The Byzantines have been defeated
Rumi (romans) qareeb ki sar-zameen mein magloob (defeat/overcome) ho gaye hain

verses.text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ

translations.text: in a nearby land. They will reverse their defeat with a victory
Aur apni is magloobiyat (defeat) ke baad chandh saal ke andar woh gaalib (victorious/dominant) ho jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: in a few years’ time––God is in command, first and last. On that day, the believers will rejoice
Allah hi ka ikhtiyar hai pehle bhi aur baad mein bhi. Aur woh din woh hoga jabke Allah ki bakshi hui fatah par musalmaan khushiyan manayenge

verses.text_uthmani: بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

translations.text: at God’s help. He helps whoever He pleases: He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
Allah nusrat (victory) ata farmata hai jisey chahta hai, Aur woh zabardast aur raheem hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: This is God’s promise: God never breaks His promise, but most people do not know;
Yeh wada Allah ne kiya hai, Allah kabhi apne wade ki khilaf warzi nahin karta. Magar aksar log nahin jaante hain

verses.text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَـٰهِرًا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ

translations.text: they only know the outer surface of this present life and are heedless of the life to come.
Log duniya ki zindagi ka bas zaahiri pehlu (outward aspect) jaante hain aur aakhirat se woh khud hi gaafil hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم ۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: Have they not thought about their own selves? God did not create the heavens and earth and everything between them without a serious purpose and an appointed time, yet many people deny that they will meet their Lord.

Kya unhon ne kabhi apne aap mein gaur-o-fikr nahin kiya? Allah ne zameen aur aasmaano ko aur un saari cheezon ko jo unke darmiyan hain barhaqq aur ek muqarrar muddat hi ke liye paida kiya hai. Magar bahut se log apne Rubb ki mulaqat ke munkir hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

translations.text: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how their predecessors met their end? They were mightier than them: they cultivated the earth more and built more upon it. Their own mes-sengers also came to them with clear signs: God did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.

Aur kya yeh log kabhi zameen mein chaley phirey nahin hain ke inhein un logon ka anjaam nazar aata jo insey pehle guzar chuke hain? Woh insey zyada taaqat rakhte thay. Unhon ne zameen ko khoob udheda(Tilled/prepare and cultivate (land) for crops) tha aur usey itna aabaad kiya tha jitna inhon ne nahin kiya hai. Unke paas unke Rasool roshan nishaniyan lekar aaye. Phir Allah unpar zulm karne wala na tha, magar woh khud hi apne upar zulm kar rahey thay

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

translations.text: Later the evildoers met a terrible end for rejecting and [repeatedly] mocking God’s revelations.
Aakir e kaar jin logon ne buraiyan ki thi unka anjaam bahut bura hua. Isliye ke unhon ne Allah ki aayat ko jhutlaya tha aur woh unka mazaq udate thay

verses.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.text: God brings creation into being; in the end He will reproduce it and it is to Him you will be recalled.
Allah hi khalq ki ibtida(originates creation) karta hai, phir wahi iska iaada (phir paida/repeat) karega. Phir usi ki taraf tum paltaye jaogey

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

translations.text: On the Day the Hour arrives, the guilty will despair
Aur jab woh sa-aat (hour/ghadi) barpa hogi us din mujrim hak-dak (dumbfounded) reh jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَـٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ

translations.text: and they will have no intercessors among those partners they ascribed to God- they will deny these partners.
Unke tehraye huey shareekon mein koi unka sifarishi (intercessor) na hoga, aur woh apne shareekon ke munkir ho jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ

translations.text: When the Hour arrives, on that Day people will be separated:
Jis roz woh sa-aat (hour/ghadi/qayamat) barpa hogi, us din (sab Insaan) alag girohon mein batt(split ) jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ

translations.text: those who believed and did good deeds will delight in a Garden,
Jo log iman laye hain aur jinhon ne neik amal kiye hain woh ek baagh mein shadaan-o-farhaan (khush haal) rakkhey jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ

translations.text: while those who disbelieved and denied Our messages and the meeting of the Hereafter will be brought for punishment.
Aur jinhon ne kufr kiya hai aur hamari aayat ko aur aakhirat ki mulaqaat ko jhutlaya woh azaab mein haazir rakkhey jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ

translations.text: So celebrate God’s glory in the evening, in the morning-
Pas tasbeeh karo Allah ki jabke tum shaam karte ho aur jab subah karte ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ

translations.text: praise is due to Him in the heavens and the earth- in the late afternoon, and at midday.
Aasmaano aur zameen mein usi ke liye hamd(praise) hai aur (tasbeeh karo uski) teesre pehar aur jabke tumpar zohar ka waqt aata hai

verses.text_uthmani: يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

translations.text: He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living. He gives life to the earth after death, and you will be brought out in the same way.
Woh zinda mein se murde ko nikalta hai aur murde mein se zinda ko nikal laata hai aur zameen ko uski maut ke baat zindagi bakashta hai.Isi tarah tumlog bhi (haalat e maut se) nikaal liye jaogey

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ

translations.text: One of His signs is that He created you from dust and- lo and behold!- you became human and scattered far and wide.
Uski nishaniyon mein se yeh hai ke usne tumko mitti se paida kiya phir yakayak tum bashar (Insaan) ho ke (zameen mein) phaylte chaley ja rahey ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: Another of His signs is that He created spouses from among yourselves for you to live with in tranquillity: He ordained love and kindness between you. There truly are signs in this for those who reflect.

Aur uski nishaniyon mein se yeh hai ke unse tumhare liye tumhari jins se biwiyan banayi taa-ke tum unke paas sukoon hasil karo aur tumhare darmiyan mohabbat aur rehmat paida kardi. Yaqeenan is mein bahut si nishaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo gaur o fikr karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: Another of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth, and the diversity of your languages and colours. There truly are signs in this for those who know.

Aur uski nishaniyon mein se aasmaano aur zameen ki paidaish, aur tumhari zubaano aur tumhare rangon (colors) ka ikhtilaf hai. Yaqeenan is mein bahut si nishaniyan hain daanishmand (wise) logon ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ

translations.text: Among His signs are your sleep, by night and by day, and your seeking His bounty. There truly are signs in this for those who can hear.
Aur uski nishaniyon mein se tumhara raat aur din ko sona aur tumhara uske fazal ko talash karna hai. Yaqeenan is mein bahut si nishaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo (gaur se) suntay hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

translations.text: Among His signs, too, are that He shows you the lightning that terrifies and inspires hope; that He sends water down from the sky to restore the earth to life after death. There truly are signs in this for those who use their reason.

Aur uski nishaniyon mein se yeh hai ke woh tumhein bijli ki chamak dikhata hai khauf ke saath bhi aur tamah (umeed) ke saath bhi. Aur aasmaan se pani barsata hai, Phir iske zariye se zameen ko uski maut ke baad zindagi bakshta hai. Yaqeenan is mein bahut si nishaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo aqal se kaam letay hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ

translations.text: Among His signs, too, is the fact that the heavens and the earth stand firm by His command. In the end, you will all emerge when He calls you from the earth.
Aur uski nishaniyon mein se yeh hai ke aasmaan aur zameen uske hukum se qayam hain, phir junhi ke usne tumhein zameen se pukara, bas ek hi pukar mein achanak tum nikal aaogey

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَـٰنِتُونَ

translations.text: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and all are obedient to Him.
Aasmaano aur zameen mein jo bhi hain uske bandey hain. Sab ke sab usi ke taabe-farmaan(obedient) hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

translations.text: He is the One who originates creation and will do it again- this is even easier for Him. He is above all comparison in the heavens and earth; He is the Almighty, the All Wise.

Wahi hai jo takhleeq ki ibtida karta hai, phir wahi uska iaada (phir paida/repeat) karega aur yeh uske liye aasaan tarr hai.Aasmaano aur zameen mein uski sifat (attribute) sabse bartar hai aur woh zabardast aur hakeem hai

verses.text_uthmani: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

translations.text: He gives you this example, drawn from your own lives: do you make your slaves full partners with an equal share in what We have given you? Do you fear them as you fear each other? This is how We make Our messages clear to those who use their reason.

Woh tumhein khud tumhari apni hi zaat se ek misal deta hai. Kya tumhare un ghulaamo mein se jo tumhari milkiyat mein hain kuch ghulam aisey bhi hain jo hamare diye huey maal o daulat mein tumhare saath barabar ke shareek hon aur tum unsey us tarah darte ho jis tarah aapas mein apne humsaron (each other)se darte ho? Is tarah hum aayaat khol kar pesh karte hain un logon ke liye jo aqal se kaam letay hain

verses.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

translations.text: And still the idolaters follow their own desires without any knowledge. Who can guide those God leaves to stray, who have no one to help them?

Magar yeh zaalim bay-samjhey boojhey apne takhailaat (desires) ke peechey chal padey hain. Ab kaun us shaks ko raasta dikha sakta hai jisey Allah ne bhatka diya ho. Aisey logon ka to koi madadgaar nahin ho sakta

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا ۚ فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: So [Prophet] as a man of pure faith, stand firm and true in your devotion to the religion. This is the natural disposition God instilled in mankind- there is no altering God’s creation- and this is the right religion, though most people do not realize it.

Pas (Aey Nabi, aur Nabi ke pairawon) yaksu hokar apna rukh is deen ki simth mein jamaa do. Qayam ho jao us fitrat par jispar Allah taala ne Insano ko paida kiya hai. Allah ki banayi hui saakht badli nahin jaa sakti. Yahi bilkul raast aur durust deen hai, magar aksar log jaante nahin hain

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

translations.text: Turn to Him alone, all of you. Be mindful of Him; keep up the prayer; do not join those who ascribe partners to God,
(Qayam ho jao is baat par)Allah ki taraf rujoo karte huey, aur daro ussey, aur namaz qayam karo , aur na ho jao un mushrikeen mein se

verses.text_uthmani: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

translations.text: those who divide their religion into sects, with each party rejoicing in their own.
Jinhon ne apna apna deen alag bana liya hai aur girohon (firkon) mein batt gaye hain. Har ek giroh ke paas jo kuch hai usi mein woh magan hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: When something bad happens to people, they cry to their Lord and turn to Him for help, but no sooner does He let them taste His blessing than- lo and behold!- some of them ascribe partners to their Lord,

Logon ka haal yeh hai ke jab unhein koi takleef pahunchi hai to apne Rubb ki taraf rujoo karke usey pukarte hain, phir jab woh kuch apne rehmat ka zaika (taste) unhein chakha deta hai to yakayak un mein se kuch log shirk karne lagte hain

verses.text_uthmani: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: showing no gratitude for what We have given them. ‘Take your pleasure! You will come to know.’
Taa-ke hamare kiye huey ehsan ki nashukri karein. Accha, mazey karlo, anqareeb tumhein maaloom ho jayega

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: Did We send them down any authority that sanctions the partners they ascribe to God?
Kya humne koi sanad aur daleel unpar nazil ki hai jo shahadat deti ho us shirk ki sadaqat par jo yeh kar rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ

translations.text: When We give people a taste of Our blessing, they rejoice, but when something bad happens to them- because of their own actions- they fall into utter despair.
Jab hum logon ko rehmat ka zaika chakhate hain to woh uspar phool jatey hain, aur jab unke apne kiya kartooton se unpar koi museebat aati hai to yakayak woh mayous honay lagte hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: Do they not see that God gives abundantly to whoever He will and sparingly [to whoever He will]? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
Kya yeh log dekhte nahin hain ke Allah hi rizq kushada karta hai jiska chahta hai aur tangg karta hai (jiska chahta hai)? Yaqeenan is mein bahut si nishaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo iman latey hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

translations.text: So give their due to the near relative, the needy, and the wayfarer- that is best for those whose goal is God’s approval: these are the ones who will prosper.
Pas (aey momin) rishtedar ko uska haqq de aur miskeen o musafir ko (uska haqq). Yeh tareeqa behtar hai un logon ke liye jo Allah ki khushnudi chahte hon, aur wahi falaah paney waley hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ

translations.text: Whatever you lend out in usury to gain value through other people’s wealth will not increase in God’s eyes, but whatever you give in charity, in your desire for God’s approval, will earn multiple rewards.

Jo sood (riba /usury /interest) tum detay ho taa-ke logon ke amwal mein shamil hokar woh badh (increase) jaye, Allah ke nazdeek woh nahin badhta (increase), aur jo zakaat tum Allah ki khushnudi haasil karne ke iradey se detey ho, usi ke dene waley dar haqeeqat apne maal badhate hain

verses.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: It is God who created you and provided for you, who will cause you to die and then give you life again. Which of your ‘partners’ can do any one of these things? Glory be to God, and exalted be He above the partners they attribute to Him.

Allah hi hai jisne tumko paida kiya, phir tumhein rizq diya, phir woh tumhein maut deta hai, phir woh tumhein zinda karega. Kya tumhare thehraye huey shareekon mein koi aisa hai jo in mein se koi kaam bhi karta ho? Paak hai woh aur bahut baala-o-bartar hai us shirk se jo yeh log karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.text: Corruption has flourished on land and sea as a result of people’s actions and He will make them taste the consequences of some of their own actions so that they may turn back.
Khushki (land) aur tarii (sea) mein fasaad barpa ho gaya hai logon ke apne haathon ki kamayi se, taa-ke maza chakkhaye unko unke baaz aamal ka, shayad ke woh baaz aayein

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ

translations.text: Say, ‘Travel through the land, and see how those before you met their end- most of them were idolaters.’
(Aey Nabi) insey kaho ke zameen mein chal phir kar dekho pehle guzre huey logon ka kya anjaam ho chuka hai. Un mein se aksar mushrik hi thay

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ

translations.text: [Prophet], stand firm in your devotion to the upright religion, before an irresistible Day comes from God. On that Day, mankind will be divided:

Pas (Aey Nabi) apna rukh mazbooti ke saath jamaa do is deen-e-raast ki simth mein qabl iske ke woh din aaye jiske tal janey ki koi surat Allah ki taraf se nahin hai.Us din log phatt kar ek dusre se alag ho jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ

translations.text: those who rejected the truth will bear the burden of that rejection, and those who did good deeds will have made good provision for themselves.
Jisne kufr kiya hai uske kufr ka wabal usi par hai, aur jin logon ne neik amal kiya hai woh apne hi liye falaah ka raasta saaf kar rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

translations.text: From His bounty God will reward those who believe and do good deeds; He does not like those who reject the truth.
Taa-ke Allah imaan laney walon aur amal-e-saleh karne walon ko apne fazal se jaza de. Yaqeenan woh kaafiron ko pasand nahin karta

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرْسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.text: Another of His signs is that He sends out the winds bearing good news, giving you a taste of His grace, making the ships sail at His command, enabling you to [journey in] search of His bounty so that you may be grateful.

Uski nishaniyon mein se yeh hai ke woh hawaein bhejhta hai basharat ke liye aur tumhein apni rehmat se behramand karne ke liye. Aur is garz ke liye ke kashtiyan uske hukum se chalein aur tum uska fazal talash karo aur uske shukar guzar banoo

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: Before you [Muhammad], We sent mes-sengers, each to their own people: they brought them clear proofs and then We punished the evildoers. We make it Our duty to help the believers.

Aur humne tumse pehle Rasoolon ko unki qaum ki taraf bheja aur woh unke paas roshan nishaniyan lekar aaye. Phir jinhon ne jurm kiya unsey humne inteqaam liya aur humpar yeh haqq tha ke hum momino ki madad karein

verses.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُۥ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُۥ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِۦ ۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

translations.text: It is God who sends out the winds; they stir up the clouds; He spreads them over the skies as He pleases; He makes them break up and you see the rain falling from them. See how they rejoice when He makes it fall upon whichever of His servants He wishes,

Allah hi hai jo hawaon ko bhejta hai aur woh baadal uthati hain. Phir woh in baadalon ko aasmaan mein phaila deta hai jis tarah chahta hai, aur unhein tukdiyon mein takseem karta hai, phir tu dekhta hai ke baarish ke qatray baadal se tapke chale aate hain. Yeh baarish jab woh apne bandon mein se jinpar chahta hai barsata hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمُبْلِسِينَ

translations.text: though before it is sent they may have lost all hope.
To yakayak woh khush o khurram ho jatey hain , halaanke iske nuzul se pehle woh mayous ho rahey thay

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

translations.text: Look, then, at the imprints of God’s mercy, how He restores the earth to life after death: this same God is the one who will return people to life after death- He has power over all things.
Dekho Allah ki rehmat ke asraat , ke murda padi hui zameen ko woh kis taraah jila uthata hai, yaqeenan woh murdon ko zindagi bakshne wala hai aur woh har cheez par qadir hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ

translations.text: Yet they will continue in their disbelief, even if We send a [scorching] wind and they see their crops turn yellow.
Aur agar hum ek aisi hawa bhej dein jiske asar se woh apni kheti ko zard paayein to woh kufr karte reh jaate hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ

translations.text: You [Prophet] cannot make the dead hear and you cannot make the deaf hear your call when they turn their backs and leave;
(Aey Nabi) Tum murdon ko nahin suna sakte, na unn behron ko apni pukar suna sakte ho jo peeth pherey bhaagay chaley jaa rahe hon

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَـٰدِ ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

translations.text: you cannot lead the blind out of their error: the only ones you can make hear you are those who believe in Our revelations and devote themselves [to Us].
Aur na tum andhon ko unki gumrahi se nikaal kar raah e raast dikha sakte ho, tum to sirf unhi ko suna sakte ho jo hamari aayat par iman latey aur sar-e-tasleem kham kar detey hain

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ

translations.text: It is God who creates you weak, then gives you strength, then weakness after strength, together with your grey hair: He creates what He will; He is the All Knowing, the All Powerful.

Allah hi to hai jisne zoaf (kamzori) ki haalat mein tumhari paidaish ki ibtida ki, phir is zoaf (kamzori) ke baad tumhein quwwat bakshi, phir is quwwat ke baad tumhein zaeef aur buda (old) kardiya. Woh jo kuch chahta hai paida karta hai, aur woh sabkuch janne wala, har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْفَكُونَ

translations.text: On the Day the Hour comes, the guilty will swear they lingered no more than an hour- they have always been deluded-
Aur jab woh sa-aat (hour) barpa hogi to mujrim kasmein kha kha kar kahenge ke hum ek ghadi bhar se zyada nahin thehre hain.Isi taraah woh duniya ki zindagi mein dhoka khaya karte thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْبَعْثِ ۖ فَهَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْبَعْثِ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: but those endowed with knowledge and faith will say, ‘In accordance with God’s decree, you actually lingered till the Day of Resurrection: this is the Day of Resurrection, yet you did not know.’

Magar jo ilm aur iman se behramand (endowed) kiye gaye thay woh kahenge ke khuda ke nawishte (record) mein to tum roz-e-hashar tak paday rahey ho. So yeh wahi roz-e-hashar hai, lekin tum jante na thay

verses.text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

translations.text: On that Day the evildoers’ excuses will be of no use to them: they will not be allowed to make amends.
Pas woh din hoga jismein zaalimon ko unki maazrat koi nafa (faida) na degi aur na unsey maafi maangne ke liye kaha jayega

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ ۚ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ

translations.text: In this Quran We have set every kind of illustration before people, yet if you [Prophet] brought them a miracle, the disbelievers would still say, ‘You [prophets] deal only in falsehood.’
Humne is Quran mein logon ko tarah tarah se samjhaya hai, tum khwah koi nishani le aao, jin logon ne maanne se inkar kardiya hai wo yahi kahenge ke tum baatil(falsehood) par ho

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: In this way God seals the hearts of those who do not know,
Is tarah thappa (seal) laga deta hai Allah un logon ke dilon par jo be-ilm hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ

translations.text: so be patient, for God’s promise is true: do not let those with no firm beliefs discourage you.
Pas (Aey Nabi) sabr karo, yaqeenan Allah ka wada sachha hai. Aur hargiz halka na payein tumko woh log jo yaqeen nahin laatey
